race.comment: LEAN ON ME (6) gets the nod after consecutive narrow seconds in BM58 company at this track, beaten a nose by Vatican Rose over 1100m before a head defeat over 1400m. She now comes back to BM54 level and has three wins and four placings from twelve starts at this track and distance. On top. FUSSY AS (2) is the immediate danger after resuming with a favourite's win in BM58 grade over this course and distance, beating DOLCE D'AMOUR by a long neck after leading and just lasting. DOLCE D'AMOUR (5) ties in closely through that same race and had a small excuse after losing gear near the 200m, while her strong track record keeps her in the mix. DAD BOD (3) was fourth in that BM58 behind FUSSY AS and LEAN ON ME and has solid track credentials. Don't discount.
